rules.editorially_shortened_anchor_not_diploma: CHAP. LXVIII. Whether Portion of Wife be great or easily obtained
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Chapter LXVIII concerns the promised portion or dowry of a prospective wife.
rules.conditions_scope_and_uncertainty: Starts PDF446/printed412 below the LXVII horizontal divider.

rules.editorially_shortened_anchor_not_diploma: whether Woman enquired after rich or not
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: A related question asks about the woman's wealth.
rules.conditions_scope_and_uncertainty: Question is framed historically, with no independently known wife or estate.

rules.editorially_shortened_anchor_not_diploma: vary your ascendant and Question man as woman
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The author says the figure must be adapted to whether a man or woman is the subject.
rules.conditions_scope_and_uncertainty: Questioner's sex alone does not dictate whether proposed spouse owns property.

rules.editorially_shortened_anchor_not_diploma: querent first house and Lord
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The first house and its ruler signify the one asking.
rules.conditions_scope_and_uncertainty: Source-native horary signification, not observed income.

rules.editorially_shortened_anchor_not_diploma: his substance and Estate second house and Lord
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The second house and ruler stand for the questioner's own estate.
rules.conditions_scope_and_uncertainty: Different from the proposed spouse's portion, assigned to eighth.

rules.editorially_shortened_anchor_not_diploma: Planet or Planets in second
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Planets placed in the second house supplement the querent's estate appraisal.
rules.conditions_scope_and_uncertainty: Placement is separate from rulership.

rules.editorially_shortened_anchor_not_diploma: Lord of Part of Fortune and its place and sign
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly also considers the Part of Fortune's ruler, placement and sign.
rules.conditions_scope_and_uncertainty: No independent numerical weighting or personal wealth validation.

rules.editorially_shortened_anchor_not_diploma: Woman he enquires after ... rich
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The paragraph brings the question back to wealth of the proposed partner.
rules.conditions_scope_and_uncertainty: Begins end PDF446 and continues PDF447.

rules.editorially_shortened_anchor_not_diploma: Sign of eighth house, Lord, Planet posited
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The eighth-house sign, ruler and planets located there are used for the partner's portion.
rules.conditions_scope_and_uncertainty: Eighth is derived second from the seventh; distinct from querent's own second.

rules.editorially_shortened_anchor_not_diploma: cusp eighth Terms of Jupiter or Venus
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The terms of Jupiter or Venus on eighth cusp are called favorable testimony.
rules.conditions_scope_and_uncertainty: A favorable cusp alone is not a measured estate outcome.

rules.editorially_shortened_anchor_not_diploma: Jupiter or Venus posited eighth
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Jupiter or Venus occupying eighth is another favorable alternative.
rules.conditions_scope_and_uncertainty: Occupancy requires subsequent condition of dignity.

rules.editorially_shortened_anchor_not_diploma: essentially dignified direct free from Combustion
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly qualifies abundant wealth by essential dignity, direct motion and absence of combustion.
rules.conditions_scope_and_uncertainty: These are conjunctive extra conditions, not optional decorative details.

rules.editorially_shortened_anchor_not_diploma: plenty of Wealth
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He predicts an ample portion under strong benefic conditions.
rules.conditions_scope_and_uncertainty: No independently validated marriage or dowry case.

rules.editorially_shortened_anchor_not_diploma: Retrograde Combust or slow in motion
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Retrogradation, combustion or slow motion reduce the favorable conclusion.
rules.conditions_scope_and_uncertainty: The original permits a considerable estate despite these hindrances.

rules.editorially_shortened_anchor_not_diploma: sufficient large portion with kind of trouble
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The author says substantial wealth might still be obtained, but with difficulties.
rules.conditions_scope_and_uncertainty: Amount versus ease of obtaining it must be scored separately.

rules.editorially_shortened_anchor_not_diploma: Lord eighth in eighth no-ways impedited
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: An unimpeded eighth lord in its house is linked to the wife's inheritance.
rules.conditions_scope_and_uncertainty: Absence of impediment is explicit.

rules.editorially_shortened_anchor_not_diploma: inheritance land Legacy estate fall to Wife
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly expects land or inherited assets to come to the woman.
rules.conditions_scope_and_uncertainty: Historical conjecture only; cannot establish legal entitlement.

rules.editorially_shortened_anchor_not_diploma: fourth or tenth and eighth Lords benevolent aspect
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He adds a supportive relationship involving fourth or tenth and eighth lords.
rules.conditions_scope_and_uncertainty: Original allows fourth OR tenth; accompanying angle/succedent qualifiers apply.

rules.editorially_shortened_anchor_not_diploma: angles succedent houses or eleventh and eighth
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Angular, succedent and particular house placements are listed as corroboration.
rules.conditions_scope_and_uncertainty: Original syntax has alternative placements; do not force simultaneity.

rules.editorially_shortened_anchor_not_diploma: more certain of inheritance
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The author increases confidence in inheritance if those supportive conditions are present.
rules.conditions_scope_and_uncertainty: Qualitative wording, not a calibrated prediction.

rules.editorially_shortened_anchor_not_diploma: Part of Fortune eighth or select dignified signs
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The original adds an eighth-house Part of Fortune and particular planetary-sign testimony to positive dowry indications.
rules.conditions_scope_and_uncertainty: The original glyph sequence around Aquarius/Leo and houses of Jupiter/Venus needs careful source-native reading.

rules.editorially_shortened_anchor_not_diploma: Jupiter or Venus trine or sextile Part Fortune
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Benefic trine or sextile to the Part of Fortune is used to affirm wealth.
rules.conditions_scope_and_uncertainty: Do not substitute all favorable aspects regardless of source planet.

rules.editorially_shortened_anchor_not_diploma: estate of quesited party sufficient
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly infers an adequate estate for the person inquired about.
rules.conditions_scope_and_uncertainty: No verified estate documents or prospective result.

rules.editorially_shortened_anchor_not_diploma: dispositor Part Fortune casts sextile or trine to it
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The ruler of the Part of Fortune making trine or sextile to the point is a further favorable alternative.
rules.conditions_scope_and_uncertainty: The source allows a dispositor alternative, not necessarily Jupiter and Venus simultaneously.

rules.editorially_shortened_anchor_not_diploma: dispositor in good aspect Jupiter or Venus
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: A favorable aspect between the fortune-dispositor and benefics is another supportive condition.
rules.conditions_scope_and_uncertainty: Distinct from aspects made directly to the Part of Fortune.

rules.editorially_shortened_anchor_not_diploma: Woman enquired after to be good Fortune
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The author describes the prospective wife as well provided for.
rules.conditions_scope_and_uncertainty: A seventeenth-century property assessment claim, not an individual wealth prediction.

rules.editorially_shortened_anchor_not_diploma: Saturn or Mars Peregrine eighth
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly cites Saturn or Mars peregrine in eighth as unfavorable.
rules.conditions_scope_and_uncertainty: It is peregrine status together with eighth location, not just the planet's identity.

rules.editorially_shortened_anchor_not_diploma: poor or little promised obtained
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He conjectures that little of the promised portion might be received.
rules.conditions_scope_and_uncertainty: No observed dowry transfer; negative predictive branch.

rules.editorially_shortened_anchor_not_diploma: extreame contention about it
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He also predicts serious disputes about payment.
rules.conditions_scope_and_uncertainty: Payment and conflict are two different possible outcomes.

rules.editorially_shortened_anchor_not_diploma: Lord eighth Combust
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Combustion of eighth-house lord is a specified obstacle.
rules.conditions_scope_and_uncertainty: Do not make combustion alone prove intentional dishonesty.

rules.editorially_shortened_anchor_not_diploma: slow performance; parents scarce able perform promises
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly expects delayed payment or inability of parents to provide the promised portion.
rules.conditions_scope_and_uncertainty: Ability to pay is distinct from fraud.

rules.editorially_shortened_anchor_not_diploma: Cauda Draconis eighth, no Fortune therein
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: South Node in eighth without beneficial occupancy is another source condition.
rules.conditions_scope_and_uncertainty: Benefic absence explicitly qualifies the scenario.

rules.editorially_shortened_anchor_not_diploma: cheating intended, more promised than performed
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The author alleges possible cheating or overpromising under that configuration.
rules.conditions_scope_and_uncertainty: Historical suspicion cannot justify accusing actual people of fraud.

rules.editorially_shortened_anchor_not_diploma: Lord eighth in second
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: An eighth-house lord in the querent's second is linked to receiving the portion.
rules.conditions_scope_and_uncertainty: This is a different house relationship from a direct aspect.

rules.editorially_shortened_anchor_not_diploma: Lord eighth sextile or trine Lord second
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: A favorable aspect between eighth and second lords is another affirmative sign.
rules.conditions_scope_and_uncertainty: Original permits either aspect, not a blanket any-aspect rule.

rules.editorially_shortened_anchor_not_diploma: querent have what promised
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He expects delivery of the promised payment under the favorable versions.
rules.conditions_scope_and_uncertainty: The historical text supplies no independently settled legal transaction.

rules.editorially_shortened_anchor_not_diploma: square Lord second
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Square aspect is distinguished from sextile/trine.
rules.conditions_scope_and_uncertainty: Square does not guarantee nonpayment; source describes difficulty.

rules.editorially_shortened_anchor_not_diploma: payment with difficulty
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The author predicts difficulty in obtaining it under a square.
rules.conditions_scope_and_uncertainty: Difficulty and permanent nonpayment must not be conflated.

rules.editorially_shortened_anchor_not_diploma: opposition Lord second
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Opposition supplies a more negative original alternative.
rules.conditions_scope_and_uncertainty: Do not collapse into square.

rules.editorially_shortened_anchor_not_diploma: never without much wrangling
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The source suggests nonpayment or protracted dispute under opposition.
rules.conditions_scope_and_uncertainty: Original clause ambiguous about the attachment of never versus wrangling.

rules.editorially_shortened_anchor_not_diploma: if no reception hardly at all
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Absence of reception is stated as making payment particularly unlikely.
rules.conditions_scope_and_uncertainty: Must retain rather than scoring an opposition without considering reception.

rules.editorially_shortened_anchor_not_diploma: impossible to give such generall Rules as always certain
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly expressly says such general rules cannot always be certain.
rules.conditions_scope_and_uncertainty: A material limit on deterministic transfer and claims of predictive reliability.

rules.editorially_shortened_anchor_not_diploma: weigh querent Condition and possibility Figure
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He advises contextual evaluation of the querent's circumstances and the figure.
rules.conditions_scope_and_uncertainty: This flexibility cannot be converted into a single deterministic scoring formula.

rules.editorially_shortened_anchor_not_diploma: CHAP. LXIX. If one be afraid of a thing
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The next numbered chapter asks whether a feared danger will occur.
rules.conditions_scope_and_uncertainty: Heading on original PDF448/printed414; no Chapter LXIX body included.
